question: A man riding on a bicycle at a speed of 36 km/hr crosses a bridge in 54 seconds. Find the length (in metres) of the bridge.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert speed into m/s: 36 × (5 ÷ 18) = 10 m/s

Length of the bridge = Speed × Time

Length = 10 × 54 = 540 m

**∴ The correct answer is 540 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the bicycle = 36 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 54 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/hr × (5 ÷ 18)
